facts.fact: The 2026 Programme Based Budget Estimates of the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations appropriate GHS 17,308,560 (GHS 15,891,503 from the Government of Ghana plus GHS 1,417,057 internally generated funds) to the ICT Capacity Development sub-programme of the Ghana-India Kofi Annan Centre of Excellence in ICT for budget year 2026.
